title: Tag
description: A quiet, static label for an attribute or category, such as "Cashless" or "Home collection".

tone.description: Colour. Soft tags use contrast-checked pairs: text.subtle/surface.sunken (neutral), action.secondary.fg/bg (brand), accent.text/accent.subtle (accent), feedback.*.fg/bg.

variant.description: soft = tinted fill (neutral adds a hairline edge), outline = hairline edge only, dashed = a placeholder or optional attribute.

uppercase.description: Small-caps style: uppercase, ~10% smaller, semibold, tracked open (0 tracking for Arabic-capable type pairs). Visual only: the DOM text keeps its case.

leading.description: Leading icon or small Avatar, sized to the tag. Decorative (aria-hidden).

children.description: The label: one to three words. Long labels truncate with an ellipsis. On the wire: a string.

fallback.description: Rendered instead of this node by a client that doesn't know its type. Must be a node that client knows.

x-syntara-rule.message: A Tag needs text in children: colour alone says nothing.
